clues.text: After the flood, Noah, a man of the soil, planted one and later drank wine from it.
King Ahab asked Naboth to hand his over to use as a vegetable garden, since it lay beside the palace.
Jesus told of workers hired at different hours of the day to labor in one, yet each received a denarius.
In a parable of Jesus, tenants who rented one seized the owner's beloved son, killed him, and threw him out.
Isaiah sang of one with a watchtower and winepress built in it that produced only sour grapes.
In a parable of Jesus, a father told two sons to work in his; one said no but later went.
The wife of noble character appraises a field and buys it, then plants one from her earnings.
